title: Kissed French Oatmeal Canel8
description: A grassy and shattering take on traditional French cuisine, featuring oatmeal and a delicate tagine-cooked flavor, perfect for a sick day. This Alsatian-inspired dish is Jain-friendly and takes the form of a canel8.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rolled oats, unsalted almonds, and salt.
Steep the mixture in the almond milk and water for 15 minutes.
In a small saucepan, warm the honey over low heat until it becomes runny.
Stir the warmed honey, ground ginger, and vanilla extract into the oat mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a canel8 mold or a 6-cup bundt pan.
Bake the canel8 for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Let the canel8 cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack.
Dust the canel8 with powdered sugar before serving.
Serve the canel8 warm, but not hot.
Let the canel8 cool completely before storing it in an airtight container.
